gallery.title: Polar Facet Concat
gallery.description: A graph-backed Chord and a Circular Stacked Bar arrive as separate, fully bound polar blocks.

file.name: chord_polar_line_nodes.csv + chord_polar_line_links.csv
file.description: Node observations and source–target relationships stored as two related tables.

gallery.composition: Facet the circular bars by node, then concatenate them with the Chord on a shared angle.

editorHelp.introduction: The Chord and Circular Stacked Bar are already bound. First split the bars by node; then drag the resulting group around the Chord.

steps.title: Split the bars by node
steps.source: Circular Stacked Bar on the canvas
steps.action: Click the Circular Stacked Bar, then click Facet in the canvas toolbar. In Facet dimensions, choose Polar, set Theta dimension to node_id, leave Radius dimension as None, and confirm.
steps.result: The bars become a polar group with one angular section per node.

steps.title: Drag the group around the Chord
steps.source: The faceted Circular Stacked Bar group
steps.target: Ring-shaped drop zone just outside the Chord
steps.action: Press and hold the faceted group and drag it to the ring outside the Chord’s outer edge. Release when the ring highlights with Concat · share ANGLE.
steps.result: The Chord and faceted bars share one center and angular alignment, with the bars outside.

steps.title: Enlarge the inner Chord
steps.target: The boundary shared with the surrounding bar group
steps.action: Select the inner Chord and drag its radial handle outward. You can also select the outer Facet and move its inner-radius handle to adjust the same boundary.
steps.result: The Chord uses more of the shared radius while the outer bar ring becomes narrower.
